description: Read the current user’s ChatGPT ad drafts, campaigns and results: status, budget, fees, spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC and CPM. Includes account availability and draft approval quotes. Set refresh=true to fetch the latest provider report; reporting is daily, not real time. Null results mean no report yet. Paginate with nextOffset. Translate errorCode into the user’s language.
name: get_chatgpt_ads
